claims.text: A DeepMD-type deep neural network potential can accurately determine melting temperatures of multicomponent high-entropy alloys.
A DeepMD-type potential can accurately determine the enthalpy of fusion of high-entropy alloys.
A DeepMD-type potential can accurately determine the entropy of fusion of high-entropy alloys.
A DeepMD-type potential can accurately determine volume change upon melting in high-entropy alloys.
A DeepMD-type potential can accurately determine liquid thermodynamic properties of high-entropy alloys.
The intervention is applicable across a large compositional space of high-entropy alloys.
The intervention applies to both high-temperature solid and liquid states.
Atomic structure and pair correlations are the structural mediators connecting composition to melting behavior.
A deep neural network potential can learn relationships between atomic structure and thermodynamic properties.
Learning structure-property relationships enables accurate prediction of melting temperature and the other listed thermodynamic properties.
The intervention will improve predictive accuracy relative to experiments, DFT calculations, and traditional machine-learning approaches.
The intervention will improve efficiency relative to experiments, DFT calculations, and traditional machine-learning approaches.
Accuracy may depend on the quality and quantity of training data.
Accuracy may depend on the complexity of the relationships between atomic structure and thermodynamic properties.

Predictions should be compared with experimental data and traditional computational methods using melting temperature, fusion enthalpy and entropy, melting volume change, and liquid thermodynamic properties.
A significant deviation from experimental data and traditional computational results would falsify the hypothesis.
